name: Lagi Blanc
source:
A stubborn, hot-headed, and loud character who tends to act before he thinks. And thanks to those traits his relationship with Sheryl rough start.
He is an easy-to-understand guy whose thoughts not only show on his face perfectly, but in addition he never even hesitates to say all of them directly.
Being an open book and positive minded, he is generally well-liked and surrounded by friends.
[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1881950/Reimei_no_Gakuen__OtomeVisual_Novel/]Steam[/url]]
